label: Gross revenue
definition: Invoiced value of goods and services before any customer deduction, excluding indirect tax.
alternative_definitions: GST-inclusive vs exclusive; whether scrap and job work income are revenue or a cost credit; whether shipping recovered is revenue

label: Sales returns
definition: Value of goods returned by customers in the period.
alternative_definitions: Booked in the period of return, or restated against the original sale period

label: Discounts and rate differences
definition: Customer-facing deductions granted, including trade discount, cash discount and rate difference credit notes.
formula: sum(fact_invoice_line.discount_amount) + sum(credit notes where reason in ('discount','rate_difference'))
alternative_definitions: Whether scheme and rebate accruals are a revenue deduction or an opex line

label: Net revenue
definition: Revenue after all declared customer-facing deductions. The denominator for every margin ratio.
alternative_definitions: Whether marketplace commission is netted here or shown as a cost; whether shipping recovered is netted; sell-in vs sell-out for franchise

label: Cost of goods sold
definition: Cost of goods sold or services delivered, per the declared account class list.
formula: opening_inventory + purchases + direct_conversion_cost - closing_inventory, or gl_class(cogs.*)
alternative_definitions: Boundary items: freight outward, freight inward, packing, power and fuel, direct labour, gateway fees, warehousing, inventory write-down. Standard vs actual costing

label: Gross profit
definition: Net revenue less cost of goods sold.
alternative_definitions: None in common use

label: Gross margin %
definition: Gross profit as a proportion of net revenue.
alternative_definitions: All variation comes from the underlying revenue and COGS definitions, not from this formula

label: Operating expenses
definition: Operating expenses excluding COGS, depreciation, amortisation, finance cost and tax.
alternative_definitions: Treatment of owner remuneration, related-party rent, CSR and donations, one-off items

label: EBITDA
definition: Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation. No statutory definition exists.
alternative_definitions: Before or after other income; with or without add-backs; under Ind AS lease rentals sit below EBITDA and inflate it relative to AS

label: EBITDA margin %
definition: EBITDA as a proportion of net revenue.
alternative_definitions: None in common use

label: Adjusted EBITDA
definition: EBITDA after declared, itemised add-backs. Never displayed without unadjusted EBITDA beside it.
alternative_definitions: Entirely dependent on the declared add-back list. Expect every company to differ

label: Depreciation and amortisation
definition: Depreciation and amortisation charged for the period.
alternative_definitions: None in common use

label: EBIT
definition: Operating profit after depreciation and amortisation.
alternative_definitions: None in common use

label: Other income
definition: Non-operating income for the period.
alternative_definitions: Whether any part is treated as operating and included in EBITDA

label: Finance cost
definition: Interest and other finance cost for the period.
alternative_definitions: None in common use

label: Profit before tax
definition: Profit before tax.
alternative_definitions: None in common use

label: Tax expense
definition: Current plus deferred tax for the period.
alternative_definitions: None in common use

label: Profit after tax
definition: Profit after tax.
alternative_definitions: None in common use

label: Cash and bank
definition: Cash and bank balances available to the business, per the declared inclusion rule.
alternative_definitions: Whether fixed deposits and margin money are included

label: Restricted cash
definition: Balances not freely available: margin money, lien-marked deposits.
alternative_definitions: None in common use

label: Trade receivables
definition: Amounts due from customers for goods and services delivered.
alternative_definitions: Whether unbilled revenue, retention money and marketplace settlement receivable are included; whether customer advances are netted

label: Inventory
definition: Value of stock held at the declared valuation basis.
alternative_definitions: Which stock types are included; weighted average vs FIFO vs standard

label: Trade payables
definition: Amounts due to suppliers.
alternative_definitions: None in common use

label: Other current assets
definition: Advances, prepaid expenses, deposits and statutory balances.
alternative_definitions: None in common use

label: Net fixed assets
definition: Gross block less accumulated depreciation.
alternative_definitions: None in common use

label: Debt
definition: Interest-bearing borrowings, per the declared inclusion rule.
alternative_definitions: Whether current maturities, bill discounting, LC acceptances and related-party loans count

label: Net debt
definition: Debt less free cash.
alternative_definitions: Whether restricted cash is deducted

label: Other current liabilities
definition: Statutory dues, employee payables, provisions and customer advances.
alternative_definitions: None in common use

label: Equity
definition: Share capital plus reserves and surplus.
alternative_definitions: None in common use

label: Operating working capital
definition: Receivables plus inventory less payables.
alternative_definitions: Whether cash, short-term debt and other current items are included

label: Working capital movement
definition: Cash effect of movements in operating working capital. An increase in receivables or inventory is a use of cash.
formula: -(delta AR + delta inventory - delta AP - delta other_operating)
alternative_definitions: None in common use

label: Operating cash flow
definition: Cash generated from operations, indirect method.
formula: metric.pbt + metric.da + metric.interest_expense - metric.other_income + metric.working_capital_change - taxes_paid
alternative_definitions: None in common use

label: Capital expenditure
definition: Investment in fixed assets.
alternative_definitions: Cash basis vs additions to gross block

label: Investing cash flow
definition: Cash used in or generated from investing activity.
alternative_definitions: None in common use

label: Financing cash flow
definition: Cash from borrowing and equity, less repayment, dividends and interest paid.
alternative_definitions: None in common use

label: Free cash flow
definition: Cash available after maintaining the asset base.
alternative_definitions: None in common use

label: Closing cash
definition: Cash at the end of the period. Must equal the balance sheet cash figure exactly.
alternative_definitions: None in common use

label: Days sales outstanding
definition: How long customers take to pay.
alternative_definitions: Period-end vs average AR; gross vs net revenue; 365 vs 360 days; countback method

label: Days payable outstanding
definition: How long the business takes to pay suppliers.
alternative_definitions: Computed on purchases, on COGS, or on COGS plus opex

label: Days inventory outstanding
definition: How long stock is held before it is sold.
alternative_definitions: Computed on COGS or on production cost; which stock types are included

label: Cash conversion cycle
definition: Days between paying for inputs and collecting from customers.
alternative_definitions: Inherits every variation from its three components

label: Volume sold
definition: Quantity sold in the declared unit.
alternative_definitions: Unit of measure, capacity basis and rejection point all vary by plant and must be declared

label: Volume produced
definition: Good output in the declared unit.
alternative_definitions: Unit of measure, capacity basis and rejection point all vary by plant and must be declared

label: Realisation per unit
definition: Average net price achieved per unit sold.
alternative_definitions: Unit of measure, capacity basis and rejection point all vary by plant and must be declared

label: Capacity utilisation %
definition: Output against practical capacity.
alternative_definitions: Unit of measure, capacity basis and rejection point all vary by plant and must be declared

label: Yield %
definition: Good output as a proportion of input consumed.
alternative_definitions: Unit of measure, capacity basis and rejection point all vary by plant and must be declared

label: GMV
definition: Gross merchandise value: the customer-facing transacted value, inclusive of GST. The top line of a consumer P&L.
alternative_definitions: Whether cancelled and returned orders are included; whether shipping charged is in GMV

label: GST
definition: Indirect tax embedded in GMV, removed to reach gross revenue.
alternative_definitions: None in common use

label: Marketing spend
definition: All advertising and promotion cost. Sits between CM1 and CM2, never inside CM1.
alternative_definitions: Whether brand and performance marketing are separated. Both sit in the CM1 to CM2 step regardless

label: Channel commission and fees
definition: Marketplace commission, platform fees and payment fees borne on channel sales.
alternative_definitions: Under the marketplace model commission earned is revenue, not a cost. See D-061

label: ROAS
definition: Net revenue per rupee of marketing spend. Correlational, never presented as a causal return.
alternative_definitions: None in common use

label: Operating cost (to CM1)
definition: Costs deducted from gross margin to reach CM1: servicing, fulfilment, offline manpower and rent. Marketing is excluded by design.
alternative_definitions: None in common use

label: CM1
definition: Gross margin less operating cost, before any marketing. Answers whether the unit economics work at all.
alternative_definitions: Which operating costs sit above CM1 versus in corporate overhead

label: CM1 %
definition: CM1 as a proportion of net revenue.
alternative_definitions: None in common use

label: CM2
definition: CM1 less all marketing spend. Answers whether marketing is paying back.
alternative_definitions: None in common use

label: CM2 %
definition: CM2 as a proportion of net revenue. The headline unit economics number.
alternative_definitions: None in common use

label: Corporate overhead
definition: Unallocated central cost, deducted below CM2 to reach EBITDA. Never allocated to a business unit or channel.
alternative_definitions: Some companies allocate. This system does not, per D-062

label: Marketing cost per order
definition: Marketing spend per order, split by acquisition and retention where the order file tags order type.
alternative_definitions: Acquisition cost per new order is the CAC analogue and is only computable where orders carry an acquisition or retention flag

label: Orders
definition: Count of distinct orders placed.
alternative_definitions: Which costs count as variable is entirely a declaration and every company differs

label: Average order value
definition: Net revenue per order.
alternative_definitions: Which costs count as variable is entirely a declaration and every company differs

label: Return rate %
definition: Value returned as a proportion of value sold.
alternative_definitions: Which costs count as variable is entirely a declaration and every company differs
